mapper.select: SELECT id, teacher_id, avatar, name, school, position, role FROM app_user WHERE id = #{userId}
SELECT s.* FROM app_user_student aus JOIN student s ON s.id = aus.student_id WHERE aus.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY s.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student (student_code, name, gender, age, class_name, disability_type, remark, social_adaptation, self_management, cognitive_level, language_comprehension, expression_ability, hobbies) VALUES (#{studentCode}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{age}, #{className}, #{disabilityType}, #{remark}, #{socialAdaptation}, #{selfManagement}, #{cognitiveLevel}, #{languageComprehension}, #{expressionAbility}, #{hobbies})
mapper.update: UPDATE app_user SET name=#{name}, school=#{school}, role=#{role}, position=#{position} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_user_current_student (user_id, student_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{studentId}) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE student_id = new.student_id
